items.title: Tim Macartney Snape - Everest: Sea To Summit (VHS)
items.description: Award-winning Australian film-maker Mike Dillon has captured the beauty, physical dtress and emotion that Tim Macartney Snape and his wife, Dr Ann Ward, experienced during the first complete ascent of Mt Everest.<div>Beginning with Tim's training runs through the shimmering heat of Western Australia
